bvi_guard.text: Fort Burt dates from the 1600s and guarded Road Town's harbour. The cannon are very proud of this and will not shut up about it.
From the wall you can see half the channel. A good spot for a pirate, a sunset or a very large sandwich.

bvi_cadet.text: I'm the Fort Burt cadet. I'm in charge of the cannon. By which I mean I polish it. It's got no balls. I've checked.
The ghost of the Governor's dog haunts the ramparts. Or a gull does. Hard to say.
